title: Interesante pero no va bien
body: Es muy interesante la app pero no funciona bien. El asesor IA Quinn no funciona, nunca contesta a tus solicitudes, se queda pensando eternamente y eso crea una sensación frustrante. Te quedas con la ganas de completar las lecciones.
author: Sisteríssima

title: Publicidad engañosa
body: Hasta que no acabas el procedimiento de inscribirte no te informan de que es bajo suscripción. En la información  que ofrece App Store debería de informar  que solo se puede usar con suscripción
author: _Daneri

title: Me siento engañada
body: Me descargué la app con ilusión después de completar un test sobre el TDAH, registró mi correo y me sale la pantalla de pago. Cuando en ningún momento se especifica si la app es gratis o de pago. Intento borrar mi cuenta porque no puedo permitírmelo, y no puedo. Cada vez que entro a la app, solo me sale lámpara pagar. Me siento engañada
author: Silvia110298

title: Paid app
body: Another app that pushes you to subscribe to use it. 19€ a month!
author: Krzysztofkrkr

title: Thank you Inflow 🫂
body: This is the first thing that ever helped me with my self acceptance, organization advice, personal and emotional regulation skills. Im truly, truly thankful.
author: Camcamcarmen

title: Beyond helpful
body: EN- They offer you a fund in case you are not able to afford the yearly service of the app and that is incredibly helpful. The different learning modules, as well as the webinars and the daily community questions help you not only to feel less alone, but t learn a lot about your brain and abouthacks on how to function. I am so thankful this app exists. Es:Ofrecen una opción en la que puedes solicitar que te financien para poder utilizar la app si realmente no puedes permitirte pagarla. Tanto los módulos de aprendizaje, como los webinars como las preguntas de la comunidad son de gran ayuda, ya que aprendes muchísimo y no te sientes solo.
author: amidnights

title: Life changing
body: Normalmente no digo este tipo de cosas, pero inesperadamente inflow (tanto la parte de las lecciones como las sesiones de coworking i focus por zoom) me está cambiando la vida. No sé cómo agradecer tanto.
author: alopcon

title: They charged me 189 euros without notification.
body:
They have charged me a subscription of 189 euros which I did not request and they have NOT notified me!!!
Please return this invoice to me as soon as possible, as I am NOT INTERESTED IN PAYING SUCH A HIGH AMOUNT and I cannot afford it.

I hope they sort it out asap, they have put me in a bind, and if not, I will report it to the consumer office. 
I have sent you several emails.

Thank you.
Montse.
author: Montse_ginger

title: I sincerely feel scammed
body:
I felt the whole process is very shady. My experience: I was open to try the app, I put my payment info there and everything. Then, the app didn’t recognize my purchase, and it also disappeared of the list of purchases of apple store, I thought It didn’t work and that the process didn’t went through. But they charged me anyway. I never had an experience like this before + such a big charge on my card at once and I didn’t even use the app because when I log in they just try to charge me again which Im
Not gonna do again 🤡 please refund me 😨
author: Vaanz522

title: Caro y sin avisar
body: No especifica que no hay versión gratuita hasta que has completado todo el registro, el plan es carísimo
author: Cristina SD

body: Trying to delete my account for month, still active
